deadline.value: Complete applications, including all three letters, are due December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027; late applications are not considered.
deadline.quote: Complete applications (including all 3 reference letters are due by December 1. Late applications will not be considered.

gre_subject.value: There is no bioengineering subject GRE; the GRE General is optional.

supervisor.value: The statement asks which faculty you would like to work with, but the page does not say an advisor's agreement is needed.

funding.value: PhD students get the Grainger Engineering five-year guarantee of fall/spring funding (tuition waiver, partial fee waiver, stipend) via fellowships, RAs and TAs.
funding.quote: Grainger Engineering Ph.D. students in their first five years of enrollment are guaranteed a funded appointment for fall and spring that includes a full tuition waiver, a partial fee waiver, and a stipend.

entry_route.value: You apply with a bachelor's background; the department lists undergraduate courses in biology, chemistry, maths and engineering it expects.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are strongly encouraged to complete the following classes during their undergraduate years.

notes: Fall entry only. Departmental fee waivers are for US citizens and permanent residents only. Successful applicants typically have GPAs above 3.5.
